problem: A tutoring center currently has $10$ enrolled students. The number of students in the center $T(t)$ increases at a rate that obeys an inhibited growth model, where $t\ge 0$ is the time in months. If the maximum capacity of the tutoring center is $95$ students, which differential equation could be used to model the student population of the center? Assume that $k>0$ is a constant of proportionality.
